title: Schema Nebula
summary: A governed one-star-per-collection map of the 65 explicit MongoDB collection targets across the Saha Textile platform.

inventory.countPolicy: One node represents one distinct target MongoDB collection. Visual clusters never collapse several physical collections into one node.
inventory.statusPolicy: A star becomes solid only when a tested current adapter model resolves to that exact ratified physical collection name. All 38 exported models declare explicit physical names; 35 match ratified graph nodes and are solid (including passwordCredentials, pinCredentials, authIdentities). authRateLimits, productQuestions, and ratingAggregates are implemented catalogue evidence but remain outside the ratified 65-node graph.

collections.label: categories
collections.purpose: Category and collection node identity, localized SEO metadata, labels, and admin lifecycle.

collections.label: categoryPlacements
collections.purpose: Multi-parent placement paths and merchandising hierarchy without corrupting category identity.

collections.label: categoryFacetConfigs
collections.purpose: Per-category and per-placement control of public filter visibility, order, display style, and counts.

collections.label: categoryRedirects
collections.purpose: SEO preservation when legacy paths are cleaned, categories are merged, or archived routes move.

collections.label: tags
collections.purpose: Loose merchandising and search labels that do not form a hierarchy.

collections.label: attributeDefinitions
collections.purpose: Reusable attribute definitions, terms, semantic defaults, display defaults, and facet eligibility.

collections.label: addonTemplates
collections.purpose: Reusable tailoring and customization fields with data-driven conditional visibility.

collections.label: products
collections.purpose: Product identity, localized SEO, classification, option definitions, merchandising, lifecycle, and searchable summary.

collections.label: productVariants
collections.purpose: First-class purchasable SKU rows, prices, stock, variant media, and option selections.

collections.label: productBundles
collections.purpose: True compound products, kits, sets, and grouped purchase composition.

collections.label: productRelations
collections.purpose: Explicit related, cross-sell, upsell, substitute, complete-the-look, and bought-together links.

collections.label: productGroups
collections.purpose: Curated product groupings, lookbooks, campaign rails, bought-together sets, and landing-page sections.

collections.label: promotions
collections.purpose: Scoped discounts, coupons, and campaigns with timing and applicability rules.

collections.label: seoRoutes
collections.purpose: Canonical route registry and SEO rendering source for products, categories, groups, content, and static pages.

collections.label: seoRedirects
collections.purpose: Legacy URL preservation, entity moves, slug changes, and archived or discontinued route handling.

collections.label: mediaAssets
collections.purpose: Reusable Spaces-backed media catalogue, localized alt text, derivative metadata, lifecycle, and SEO evidence.

collections.label: faqEntries
collections.purpose: Translatable editorial FAQ entries targeted to global, category, product, or mixed surfaces.

collections.label: contentBlocks
collections.purpose: Translatable CMS blocks, category editorial copy, product help, and SEO-safe page content.

collections.label: reviews
collections.purpose: Verified-purchase product ratings and reviews with optional media and admin moderation.

collections.label: searchDictionary
collections.purpose: Curated transliteration, misspelling, synonym, and merchandising query intelligence.

collections.label: searchOutbox
collections.purpose: Reliable asynchronous synchronization from authoritative MongoDB records to the derived search index.

collections.label: searchQueryAggregates
collections.purpose: Aggregate popular searches, suggestions, no-result analysis, and spell-correction learning.

collections.label: carts
collections.purpose: Server-authoritative guest and user carts, merge state, selected configurations, and sliding guest expiry.

collections.label: orders
collections.purpose: Commerce record with immutable purchase-time snapshots and customer-facing order lifecycle.

collections.label: payments
collections.purpose: Gateway attempts, verification, capture, settlement, and failure data separated from orders.

collections.label: shipments
collections.purpose: Domestic and international shipment lifecycle independent of order and payment state.

collections.label: returns
collections.purpose: Item-level return request, approval, receipt, inspection, and restock disposition.

collections.label: refunds
collections.purpose: Financial reversal records independent of return logistics and aggregate order status.

collections.label: taxClasses
collections.purpose: Reusable GST and HSN classification identities without baking tax policy permanently into products.

collections.label: taxRules
collections.purpose: Versionable jurisdiction and rate rules applied through reusable tax classes.

collections.label: currencies

collections.label: currencyExchangeRates
collections.purpose: Persisted exchange-rate history and audit evidence for INR-derived currency conversion.

collections.label: paymentGatewayConfigs
collections.purpose: Payment gateway routing and non-secret operational configuration; credentials stay in runtime secrets.

collections.label: paypalCommissionRules
collections.purpose: Versioned, admin-editable PayPal percentage and fixed-fee gross-up settings per currency.

collections.label: shippingProviderConfigs
collections.purpose: Non-secret domestic and international shipping configuration behind the shipping port.

collections.label: shippingRateQuotes
collections.purpose: Quote snapshots for checkout, order audit, provider reconciliation, and margin reporting.

collections.label: purchaseInvoices
collections.purpose: Supplier purchase-invoice intake for stock, cost provenance, and purchase and profit reporting.

collections.label: purchaseInvoiceLines
collections.purpose: Supplier invoice line replication and stock intake per product or variant.

collections.label: inventoryLedger
collections.purpose: Stock audit and adjustment provenance without introducing warehouse-management complexity.

collections.label: inventoryCostLayers
collections.purpose: FIFO unit-cost history for COGS, stock valuation, and margin reporting.

collections.label: analyticsEvents
collections.purpose: Short-retention storefront and admin event capture for bounded reporting rollups.

collections.label: analyticsDailyAggregates
collections.purpose: Daily materialized metrics that avoid expensive dashboard scans over raw events and orders.

collections.label: businessReportSnapshots
collections.purpose: Frozen reporting snapshots for consistent business and financial views.

collections.label: productInsightSets

collections.label: productBadgeAssignments

collections.label: customers

collections.label: adminUsers

collections.label: authIdentities

collections.label: passwordCredentials
collections.purpose: Password hashes and credential policy state separated from the public user profile.

collections.label: pinCredentials
collections.purpose: Password-grade admin and staff PIN hashes, lockout state, and login preference evidence.

collections.label: authSessions
collections.purpose: Server-side sessions, opaque refresh-token families, rotation, reuse detection, CSRF binding, and UA-derived device.label for operator/customer session lists.

collections.label: otpChallenges
collections.purpose: Single-use, expiring, rate-limited OTP challenges stored as hashes rather than plaintext codes.

collections.label: oauthStates
collections.purpose: Short-lived OAuth state, nonce, verifier, redirect, and guest-cart continuation evidence.

collections.label: passwordResetTokens
collections.purpose: Hashed, expiring, single-use password reset credentials.

collections.label: emailVerificationTokens
collections.purpose: Hashed email-verification credentials kept separate from OTP login challenges.

collections.label: adminInvites
collections.purpose: Controlled, expiring, auditable staff and admin invitation lifecycle.

collections.label: roles

collections.label: adminUserRoleAssignments
collections.purpose: Explicit operator-to-role assignments with lifecycle and auditability.

collections.label: pendingIntents

collections.label: consentEvents

collections.label: auditLogs

collections.label: notificationChannelSettings

collections.label: notificationTemplates
collections.purpose: Approved channel templates, provider template identifiers, and localized email content.

collections.label: messageOutbox
collections.purpose: Durable notification delivery attempts, provider correlation, retries, and suppression outcomes.

collections.label: sequences
collections.purpose: Transactional allocation state for order, tax-invoice, purchase-invoice, and future document numbers.
